subject: Discovery follow-up: NovaPay buying path + security kickoff
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@novapay.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 13:04:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery follow-up: NovaPay buying path + security kickoff

Hi Sofia / Evan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same page: 

Summary of call:
- Primary use case: transaction enrichment and real-time fraud-flagging assistant for customer support agents.
- Traffic profile: 400–600 TPS at peak for inference requests (chat-like prompts), with 6–12 token responses on average.
- Decision criteria: latency under 150ms p95, clear data residency for PII, and a predictable pricing model for unit economics.

Stakeholders you named on the call (rough):
- Economic buyer: Evan Brooks (VP Product) — owns procurement budget and go/no-go
- Security owner: Amy Chen (Infosec) — will drive questionnaire and audit items
- Procurement: procurement@novapay.com — handles T&Cs and SOW redlines
- Day-to-day technical lead: Sofia Alvarez — will coordinate integration and test plan

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) Amy / security to share NovaPay security questionnaire or a short intake. If you already have a template please attach it.
2) Procurement to outline the procurement timeline and any required templates (PO, MSAs).
3) Redwood to prepare a tailored security-intake workbook and a short tech appendix (we'll include perf numbers and model variants).
4) Schedule a dedicated security kickoff next week to run through scope (systems in scope, data flows, retention, logging).

I can own collating answers and keeping the channel moving. For internal coordination I’m looping Marissa for commercial terms, Sean for SE support, and Monica for the security intake.

Proposed kickoff slots (I put these in the shared calendar link): Tue/Nov 9 14:00–15:00 ET or Wed/Nov 10 10:00–11:00 ET. Let me know what works.

Attachments: I will send a short intake workbook once I have your questionnaire.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novapay.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia@novapay.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novapay.com>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: NovaPay buying path + security kickoff

Thanks Rafael — good summary. 

I’m attaching NovaPay's standard security questionnaire (PDF). A few clarifications up front so your team can scope answers: 
- Systems in scope: anything that processes customer PII or transaction data (our primary concern is inference endpoints that touch PANs or CVV; for now we plan to tokenize sensitive fields before calls but need to understand Redwood's retention and KV cache behavior).
- Logging / audit: we need per-request logs (redacted for PII) retained for 90 days and exportable to our SIEM (S3/CloudTrail acceptable).
- Encryption: TLS + customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) required for private deployment; for hosted proof-of-concept we can discuss limited exceptions.

Procurement timeline: we usually do a 4–6 week process for pilots (internal approvals + legal). Procurement will confirm exact dates once we have draft SOW and pricing.

I've attached: NovaPay_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (answers due ideally in 5 business days).

Amy Chen
Head of Information Security, NovaPay
amy.chen@novapay.com

Attachment: NovaPay_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: NovaPay — stakeholder map + next steps (security questionnaire received)

Team —

Quick internal note: Amy sent their security questionnaire (attached in thread). I want to align on owners and timeline before I send back our intake. High level asks below: 

Owners I propose:
- Security questionnaire responses (detailed Q&A): Monica Patel (lead), Sean Gallagher (SE input for architecture/ops)
- Commercial / SOW / pricing: Marissa Cole (lead)
- Procurement liaison / contract cadence: Neha Kapoor (procurement ops advise)
- Thread owner / single point for external comms: Rafael (I'll collate and run responses)

Scope clarifications needed from security team: 
- Confirm whether tokenization approach is sufficient for PII (we can provide our recommended redaction patterns).
- Clarify required audit export format (S3 path or syslog endpoint).
- Confirm preferred deployment model for pilot: hosted vs dedicated vs private. Amy mentioned private with CMK is preferred for production, hosted allowed for limited POC.

Timing: Amy asked for answers within ~5 business days. We should prioritize an initial pass (core controls, encryption, retention) by EOD Fri Nov 6 so I can return a first draft. Monica — can you confirm availability?

Also: we should include a short appendix with latency/throughput numbers and cache behavior for their traffic profile — Sean, can you draft a one-pager?

Thanks — Rafael

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: NovaPay — stakeholder map + next steps (security questionnaire received)

Rafael — thanks for the split. I can lead the questionnaire response. Immediate plan: 
1) I'll take the controls sections and mark anything that is a product/design question for the SEs.
2) Sean — please provide the cache/latency one-pager and sample config (batching, KV eviction, tokenization notes) by tomorrow EOD. That'll cover the technical appendix.
3) I will draft answers for the controls we cover in hosted mode and note where CMK/private deployment is required for production.
4) I'll add an audit export spec (S3 + CloudTrail-compatible events) and note retention settings — we can propose a 90-day baseline with an optional 365-day enterprise retention add-on.

Attachments: redwood-security-summary.pdf (one-page that maps their questionnaire sections to our product controls). I will upload the detailed draft to the shared drive link Rafael included.

I can join the kickoff on Tue/Nov 9 14:00 ET if that remains viable.

Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-security-summary.pdf (PDF)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novapay.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia@novapay.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novapay.com>, procurement@novapay.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: NovaPay buying path + security kickoff — intake and proposed kickoff

Hi Amy / Sofia / Evan —

Appreciate the questionnaire — attaching our intake workbook (redwood-security-intake.xlsx) with Monica's initial answers and Sean's appendix. The workbook highlights two areas where we need short clarifications from your side:
- Whether NovaPay will accept tokenization at the edge or requires strict client-side tokenization for all PCI data (we indicated tokenization is acceptable for pilot but flagged it as production requirement if not).
- Export endpoint: we proposed S3 + CloudTrail-compatible events; confirm preferred S3 bucket destination + role access or a syslog endpoint.

Commercial note: Marissa will prepare a pilot SOW and pricing worksheet. As discussed, procurement timeline typically ~4–6 weeks; if we can get SOW draft in the next 3 business days we can compress approvals.

Confirming kickoff slot Tue Nov 9 14:00–15:00 ET — I'll send a calendar invite to everyone in this thread. If that time no good, please propose alternatives.

Next steps checklist (my ownership noted):
- [Rafael] Deliver intake workbook (attached) — DONE (see attachment).
- [Monica/Sean] Finalize controls appendix and where production requires private deployment — target Mon Nov 8 EOD.
- [Marissa] Draft pilot SOW and preliminary pricing — target Wed Nov 11.
- [Neha] Prep an MSA/PO checklist and any standard redlines we should expect from NovaPay procurement.

Thanks all — looking forward to kickoff.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-security-intake.xlsx (XLSX); redwood-security-summary.pdf (PDF)
